intent: Hold the leading icon, image or avatar of an item row.
typical_uses: An icon, a thumbnail or an avatar at the start of an Item

dont_use_when.situation: The illustration of a region that has nothing to show
An image that runs to the edges of a bounded panel

instead.target: Card, with the image as its direct child

invariants.text: ItemMedia is a centered, non-shrinking flex box; `variant="icon"` sizes every svg inside it to --icon-size-sm, and `variant="image"` makes a 2.5rem square with a small radius that clips its content and makes every img inside it cover the square. Every svg inside ItemMedia ignores pointer events whatever the variant.

good.title: A thumbnail cropped to the media square

bad.title: A size prop guessed for the image
bad.why: ItemMedia declares no `size`; the image square already shrinks to follow the surrounding Item's `size`, so set `size="sm"` on the Item.
